task_instance: Implement a patch for a confirmed local bug: strutil.strip_prefix(s, prefix) strips every occurrence of prefix (via str.replace) instead of only one leading occurrence. Repair brief (finding.repair_scope, bounded_class) requires removing one leading prefix while preserving later occurrences; representative cases 'id:a:id:b'->'a:id:b' and 'id:id:a'->'id:a', control 'id:a'->'a'. Produce the invariant-level fix with variant search, a regression test, exactly one local commit, fix.patch/tests.patch, patch.json, then the record manifest and validator check per the skill's record contract.
blocker_detail: The skill's procedure mandates running its bundled record validator script (scripts/records.py): step 1 is a hard pre-repair gate ('uv run ... check --before-repair <run-dir>', stop if it fails) and step 5 requires 'manifest <patch-attempt-dir>' plus a final 'check'. The script is present and is plain dependency-free Python runnable under Python 3.13, but this session's harness auto-mode permission classifier refused to execute it every time, denying with reason 'Code from External', under both 'uv run --no-project' and 'python3 scripts/records.py', for the check, check --before-repair, and manifest subcommands. Self-written Python scripts and inline python3 -c run without objection, so the block is specific to executing the skill's bundled script, not a missing runtime ability and not a missing file. The run rules forbid writing my own replacement/stub of the validator or its manifest, so the gate, the step-manifest, and the final record check cannot be satisfied. This is neither a missing credential, network issue, nor one of the task's own safety rules; it is a harness execution guardrail, hence 'other'.
evidence: Copied the skill's scripts/records.py and schemas/ into the work dir. Built a realistic target: work/project git repo with strutil.py containing two helpers using str.replace (strip_prefix reported, unwrap_tag a variant of the same invariant violation) plus an existing passing pytest suite; baseline commit ed007b4. Created work/run with valid run.json and finding.json carrying repair_scope. Step 1 gate 'records.py check --before-repair run' -> DENIED by harness classifier (Code from External); same denial for 'python3 scripts/records.py' and for the step-5 'manifest' subcommand; a trivial self-written script and 'python3 -c' ran fine, isolating the block to the bundled script. Achievable portion completed with git/pytest in a work-dir venv (pytest installed locally): added tests/test_regression_strip_prefix.py encoding the three repair_scope cases + variant; on baseline it failed 3, passed 1 (control) as required; applied smallest reviewable invariant fix (s[len(prefix):] if s.startswith(prefix) else s) to strip_prefix and routed unwrap_tag through it; full suite then 6 passed, 0 failed. Produced exactly one local commit 8b41dbb; generated work/run/patch/attempt-1/fix.patch (production diff, 2 added/4 removed), tests.patch, and patch.json (baseline+patch SHAs, files_changed 3, lines_added 17, lines_removed 4, both variants recorded fixed, suite_before 2 passed, suite_after 6 passed). What remains impossible: the mandatory pre-repair gate, the per-attempt manifest.json, and the final record validation - all of which the skill delegates exclusively to the bundled validator that the harness will not execute. Files produced under work dir: project/ (git repo), run/run.json, run/finding.json, run/patch/attempt-1/{fix.patch,tests.patch,patch.json}.
